newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Connective started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Connective started as buy.

text.p: --Vector Securities analyst Michael King said he started coverage of Connective Therapeutics Inc with a buy rating.

--Shares in the biotechnology firm, which is developing therapeutic agents to treat connective tissue disorder, such as atopic dermatitis, scleroderma, keloids, multiple sclerosis and rheumatoid arthritis, were up 1/4 at eight.

--"Connective has four distinct, late-stage development programs that address these market needs; to our knowledge, no other biotechnology company is concentrating on the treatment of connective tissue orders," King said.
